Market today:
The market's mood is tense, driven by a hot jobs report pushing up the 2-year yield. This signals higher interest rate expectations from the Fed, which is a real headwind for your tech and chip names. Higher rates make future earnings less valuable and increase borrowing costs.

Your holdings:
SOXL is a major concern, down -54.4% and flagged SELL. As a leveraged ETF, it decays and amplifies losses, especially on margin. SPAL, another leveraged ETF, is new but already down -32.21%. SMH is also flagged TRIM, down -11.22%. Margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on interest rate movements and any further Fed commentary. Also, watch your stops on SOXL and SPAL very closely.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management on your leveraged and underperforming positions in this rising rate environment.
plays: Consider reducing SOXL exposure given its SELL status, -54.4% loss, and leveraged decay risk, especially with rising rates.
Trim SMH at its current price of 564.95, respecting the 540 stop, as it's flagged for attention.
Consider adding to CRWD, which has an 'ACCUMULATE' scanner signal at 212.09-211.88 with a stop at 210.64.
